summary: Amesite Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 696,866 common shares at $1.435 per share, via a securities purchase agreement dated April 27, 2026, with concurrent private placement of pre-funded warrants and Series A-1/A-2 warrants to the same institutional investors. The placement agent is H.C. Wainwright. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
